SELECT , NULL AS wishlisted, 0 AS other_pressing_count
WHERE p.album_id = #{albumId} AND p.status <> 'HIDDEN' ORDER BY p.pressing_year IS NULL, p.pressing_year ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.artistName, (SELECT MIN(pi.image_url) FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = t.id AND pi.sort_order = 0) AS thumbnailUrl FROM ( SELECT p.id, p.title, a.name AS artistName, p.review_count AS review_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.album_id ORDER BY (p.status = 'SOLD_OUT'), CASE WHEN p.title LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 0 WHEN a.name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.review_count DESC, p.id DESC ) AS rn FROM product p JOIN artist a ON a.id = p.artist_id WHERE p.status <> 'HIDDEN' AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.title LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 0 WHEN t.artistName LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, t.review_count DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
